availableCommands.name: $brand:audience-personas
availableCommands.description: Build a cast of 3–5 vivid, named customer personas from a frozen BRAND.md so campaigns and copy target one specific person. Use when the user says "personas", "customer avatar", "target customers as real people", "who are we marketing to", wants to brain-dump a character and have it cleaned up, or wants to run different campaigns at different audience members. Skip if BRAND.md is missing or draft (run brand-foundation first). Skip evidence-level segmentation itself (brand-foundation owns segments) and campaign execution (marketing plugin).

availableCommands.name: $brand:brand-foundation
availableCommands.description: Build brand voice, audience segments, positioning, and visual constraints from a frozen VALIDATION.md. Writes BRAND.md as the source of truth for later copy, ads, and product UI. Use when the user says "brand voice", "positioning", "target audience", "ICP segments", "brand design", or "who is this for" after an idea has been validated. Skip if VALIDATION.md is missing, KILL, or still draft. Skip blank-page ads/copy (marketing plugin) and software UI implementation (engineering / ui).

availableCommands.name: $brand:offer-design
availableCommands.description: Design or overhaul a business offer — value-equation tuning, obstacle-to-solution stack, guarantee selection, naming, and price posture — outside or ahead of funnel work. Use when the user says "design the offer", "pricing", "guarantee", "package this", "grand slam offer", "why isn't this converting" (when the offer is the suspect), or "name this product/offer". Requires VALIDATION.md GO — refuse and redirect to idea-validation when missing. For a funnel's inline offer framing, funnel-system handles it; use this skill for standalone offer work or a deep overhaul.

availableCommands.name: $brand:persona-refresh
availableCommands.description: Reconcile a frozen persona cast with real campaign or product data — flat CTR, dead campaigns, churn, reply rates. Use when the user says "the persona is wrong", "update my personas", "this campaign flopped", or brings performance exports that contradict PERSONAS.md. Requires frozen PERSONAS.md (index) plus the `business/personas/pN-*.md` files it lists, plus actual performance data — no data, no refresh. Skip creative fixes (ad-creative-pipeline / direct-response-copy) and building the cast in the first place (audience-personas).

availableCommands.name: $brand:product-voice
availableCommands.description: Turn the frozen persona cast into in-app copy guidance — push notifications, empty states, paywall, errors, success moments — as a PRODUCT-VOICE.md engineering consumes. Use when the user says "in-app copy", "notification copy", "microcopy", "empty states", "paywall copy", "make the app talk like the personas", or a product repo starts consuming brand voice. Requires frozen PERSONAS.md — redirect to audience-personas when missing. Skip marketing assets (direct-response-copy) and UI implementation (engineering / ui plugins).

availableCommands.name: $core:os-router
availableCommands.description: Route Founder OS requests by task and repository context. Use at session entry, when choosing a workflow, or for "what should I work on". Works for infrastructure, software, and ventures; delegates venture assessment separately.

availableCommands.name: $core:plugin-curator
availableCommands.description: Choose Founder OS plugins for this repository across Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. Use for repository onboarding, "trim plugins", "which plugins do I need here", "reduce plugin context", changing the active selection, or saving/restoring plugin reminder preferences.

availableCommands.name: $core:project-journal
availableCommands.description: Keep a per-project journey log in the founder home — dated, append-only raw entries capturing what shipped, what was decided, what broke, and why it mattered, written as blog source material while the memory is fresh. Use when the user says "update the journal", "journey doc", "log this milestone", when a significant project event just happened (a GO/KILL decision, a launch, a first customer, a pivot, a system shipped), or at the end of a substantial working session on any tracked project. Not a session report (session-hygiene owns repo-level reports), not marketing copy (source-material-content consumes this later), and not the venture command file (venture-assessment).

availableCommands.name: $core:provision
availableCommands.description: Detect, install, and verify the external dependencies other skills need — MCP servers, CLIs, local toolchains, and security scanners such as ZAP, Schemathesis, Semgrep, and Trivy. The single place install instructions live; every other skill only probes for existence and routes here when something is missing. Use when a skill reports a missing dependency, or the user says "set up perplexity", "install the resolve mcp", "provision heygen", "install the security scanners", "set up ZAP", or "why can't this skill find X".

availableCommands.name: $herdr-synapse
availableCommands.description: Coordinate with teammates on a herdr-synapse board inside a Herdr session. Use only when HERDR_ENV=1 and `herdr-synapse me` succeeds, or when a line starting with [herdr-team appears in your input.

availableCommands.name: $imagegen
availableCommands.description: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas.

availableCommands.name: $openai-docs
availableCommands.description: Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, and self-knowledge; OpenAI APIs and ChatGPT Work. 'You'/'this app' means Codex only.

availableCommands.name: $review-agent
availableCommands.description: Perform a read-only, defect-first review of a specified code change and return every actionable finding. Use when another agent delegates review of uncommitted changes, a base-branch diff, a commit, or custom review instructions.

availableCommands.description: Create or update a skill

availableCommands.description: Install curated skills from openai/skills or other repos
